newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says S.Australia well flows gas.
newsitem.headline: Santos says S.Australia well flows gas.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Tuesday its Nephrite South One exploration well in the South Australian section of the Cooper/Eromanga basin flowed gas at the rate of 3.725 million cubic feet per day, proving a new pool discovery.
Santos said the flow was from reservoir sands in the Early Permian Patchawarra Formation over the interval 2,784-2,808 metres.
The well is 3.5 km south of the Nephrite One gas field, discovered in January, and about 55 km northwest of the Moomba gas plant.
"The well will drill ahead through further potential pay zones to a total depth of 3,249 metres," Santos said.
Santos, the operator, holds a 59.75 percent interest in the Patchawarra Southwest Block.
Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd, a unit of Exxon Corp, holds 20.21 percent, Boral Energy Resources Ltd has 13.19 percent, Crusader Resources NL 4.75 percent and Basin Oil NL 2.1 percent.
